text:
Zapier uses Firecrawl to power custom web knowledge in Zapier Chatbots, letting customers connect their public websites and help centers directly to AI chatbots. No scraping code required.
When you're building a chatbot product, the difference between a useful bot and a great one often comes down to knowledge. A chatbot that can only answer generic questions has limited value. One that can reference a business's actual products, support docs, and FAQs becomes something customers can genuinely rely on.
Andrew Gardner, Senior Engineer, Chatbots at Zapier, and his team understand this well. Zapier Chatbots lets users build AI chatbots that answer questions, resolve issues, and nurture leads with the power of automation. To deliver on that promise, Zapier needed a reliable way to bring external web knowledge into their product.
What problem does web knowledge solve for chatbot users?
The most common use cases: lead generation and customer support. Users want their chatbots to answer FAQs about their business or events, pulling directly from content that already exists on their website.

Pulling data from the web is crucial because it allows chatbots to access information on customers' public websites and help centers.

— Andrew Gardner, Senior Engineer — Chatbots, Zapier
This meant Zapier needed a way to let users connect web sources to their chatbots effortlessly, without requiring custom integrations or manual data work on their end.
How does Firecrawl power Zapier Chatbots?
Firecrawl is integrated directly into Zapier Chatbots as the engine behind custom web knowledge sources. When a user points their chatbot at a website or help center, Firecrawl handles the extraction and delivers that content into the product.

Firecrawl lets them (users) effortlessly pull in this valuable content directly into our product.

The integration covered two of the most important user needs: letting businesses feed their chatbots with real, up-to-date content from their own sites, and making that process accessible without technical expertise.
What made Firecrawl the right fit?
The decision came out of a standard vendor evaluation. Andrew came across Firecrawl and quickly had a prototype running.

Integrating Firecrawl was seamless. An engineer found it during our vendor evaluation and quickly had a prototype running.

Beyond the technical ease, the breadth of Firecrawl's endpoints and AI-first features aligned well with Zapier's product roadmap:

We were especially excited by all of Firecrawl's endpoints and AI first features which align well with our roadmap.

And when questions came up at launch, the Firecrawl team went further than expected:

The Firecrawl team answered all of our questions and even connected us directly with their engineers when we had questions at launch.
